reference_resources.counting_method: Each LUT primitive is counted once before packing; LUT RAM and SRL use their architectural LUT storage requirements. Packing may combine compatible logic LUTs or insert routing LUTs. A placed design supplies physical_lut_sites_after_placement.

reference_boundary.scope: Module input rd_valid[0] to actual synchronous data/control pins

paths.path_method: Connected bit graph from clocked storage to synchronous data/control inputs. LUT6_2 O5 excludes I5, CARRY4 dependencies follow carry direction, and asynchronous memory outputs depend on read addresses. DSP register parameters define clocked boundaries. Arithmetic between an input port and an internal register, between internal registers, or between an internal register and an output port contributes one DSP cell for that connected segment. Direct registered outputs contribute zero arithmetic cells. Unregistered DSP paths retain conservative input dependencies, including the A:B ALU bypass. Counts describe structural depth; primitive and routing delays require device timing analysis.
